notes.title: Craft Your Perfect Monster | Voidling Bound - Monster Taming Direct 2025 Trailer
notes.content: [p]Hello Steam community![/p][p][/p][p]Straight out of Gym Leader Ed's [b]MONSTER TAMING DIRECT 2025![/b] We're happy to showcase our latest trailer for Voidling Bound! Let's dive... into the Splicing Station!🧬[/p][previewyoutube="vfa68R8c6ik;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Explore the depth of the splicing system that allows you to utilize your gene collection and craft your perfect Voidling. Then, meet Gwigoon, a mischievous master of self-replication that wields its clones in combat for devastating effects.[/p][p][/p][p][b]|| The new features revealed today are not part of our demo. Expect them for the full release. ||[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We're super excited to hear what you think of the trailer! [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all and please leave a comment![/p][p][/p][p][i]-Hatchery Games[/i][/p][p]=============================[/p][p][b]About Monster Taming Direct 2025:[/b][/p][p]Monster Taming Direct is a yearly online event celebrating the Monster Taming genre. Featuring games about capturing, training, and battling with creatures. Hosted on the [url="https://www.youtube.com/@GymLeaderEd"]Gym Leader Ed[/url] Youtube channel, it brings together more then 40 studios to showcase exclusive new trailers, dev logs, and announcements.[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Voidling Bound Demo - Now available in Japanese
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]BitSummit 2025 is going live and so is our demo update!! Alongside the japanese localization, we are updating our demo with some new features and minor changes to the current build.[/p][p][/p][p]A huge thank you to our users who have helped us with this update! We hope to see you all try these changes and we are eager to meet new users![/p][p][/p][h3][b]PATCH NOTES[/b][/h3][p][b]Features Added:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Japanese localization,[/p][/*][*][p]You can now rename your Voidlings,[/p][/*][*][p]New music inside the ship,[/p][/*][/list][p][b]UI:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Stamina bar rework,[/p][/*][*][p]Melee Ability now has an ability icon in the Combat Hud,[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Adjustments:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Changed Wrangler jump animation inside the ship,[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Wrangler walk speed,[/p][/*][*][p]Creature walk and run speed increased,[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Research Point Pick Up Radius,[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]Difficulty Balancing:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Adventurer has been made a bit more challenging than previously to make it a better in-between of Collector and Fighter,[/p][/*][*][p]Wrangler difficulty is even harder than before with fewer health sources available to players,[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies health pool rebalance to make stronger archetypes more important in combat,[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]Bug Fixes:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Fixed critical damage values - when the player assigned exactly 7 points of strength it lowered the value from 200% to 21% instead of increasing it to 210%,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed crashes when leaving Activity due to undestroyed actors (Mirage Gilick's Minion),[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Kwipeck's Fuming Zone remaining in levels.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Known Issues:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Loading an older Save Game may result in Vireo's mission appearing as incomplete, even if it was previously completed.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: BitSummit 2025: Demo Available In Japanese
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We'll be attending[b]「BitSummit the 13th Summer of Yokai」[/b]in Kyoto, Japan to showcase our demo for Voidling Bound![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Starting Friday July 18th, the demo for Voidling Bound will become available in Japanese![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]If you are at BitSummit the 13th, we hope to see you in big numbers at our booth! Please swing by and say hello![/p][p][/p][p]Cheers![/p]

notes.title: Our Demo Is Out! Play Now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are very excited to launch our demo to the public during Steam's Creature Collector Fest! We hope to see lots of you try the game out!

So come play the game ! Give us your thoughts, expectations, feedback about the game ! We want to hear what you have to say so we can make this game as best as it can be !

Please send us your best Voidlings screenshot! Discuss your favorite builds! Which is your favorite Voidling?

Have fun ! and see you in space!
